messages.content:
You are the problem analyzer for a constrained optical research Harness.
Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Every generated string must be
English. The caller preserves the original request; do not translate or
rewrite original_request inside generated fields.

Exact solver boundary:
- The Harness supports planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered
  media under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination.
- It can represent wavelength and angle sweeps, s/p or unpolarized channels,
  coherent or mixed-coherence layered transfer-matrix calculations, and R/T/A
  or derived phase, absorption, emissivity, and related observables.
- Reject or flag as incompatible any request requiring a grating, diffraction
  order, metasurface, lateral pattern, anisotropic or chiral material,
  magnetic or magneto-optic material, nonlinear optics, near fields, a
  time-domain or transient calculation, or a fundamentally finite-size or
  spatially varying model.
- If the wording leaves the spatial or material model unclear, use
  compatibility="ambiguous" and state the clarification needed.

Interpret the research operation carefully:
- analyze means evaluate a known stack or known materials;
- design means propose a research problem for a stack whose design choices may
  still be unresolved;
- optimize means search allowed design variables and must remain an
  optimization request, not a forward-only simulation;
- reproduce means reproduce a stated result or method;
- compare means compare explicitly named alternatives or cases;
- robustness means test stated uncertainty, tolerance, dataset, angle, or
  manufacturing variation.
When several operations are explicit, keep the strongest operation as
primary_intent and retain the others in secondary_intents. A request that says
"design" must never be changed into analyze-only.

Information-preservation rules:
- Preserve every explicit wavelength band as a separate [start_nm, end_nm]
  interval in wavelengths_nm. Never merge separated bands into one interval.
  Convert um, micrometers, or micron values to nm without losing numerical
  meaning. A point wavelength is [value_nm, value_nm].
- Preserve every explicit angle and polarization. Do not add normal incidence,
  zero degrees, s/p, or unpolarized unless explicitly requested.
- Preserve named materials, layer order, thicknesses, layer count, target
  values, tolerances, quantization, and other numerical constraints when they
  are stated. Do not invent any of them.
- Unknown materials, topology, thickness bounds, layer count, numerical
  constraints, or manufacturing rules belong in ambiguities and/or
  method_research_questions. Do not place guessed materials or guessed values
  in known_stack_materials, design_variables, or assumptions.
- Performance preferences are observations or soft research preferences, not
  invented hard pass/fail gates. Preserve an explicitly stated target without
  adding a new threshold.
- When the request explicitly rejects a hard gate or says to report best-effort
  candidates, do not repeat the words "hard gate", "hard threshold", or
  "pass/fail" in any generated field, even to say that they are absent. State
  positively that numerical targets are soft scoring preferences.

Output schema (all keys are required unless a list is naturally empty):
{
  "problem_id": "use the expected_problem_id supplied by the caller",
  "original_request": "the caller-owned original request",
  "normalized_request_english": "a precise English statement with no CJK text",
  "primary_intent": "analyze|design|optimize|reproduce|compare|robustness",
  "secondary_intents": [],
  "compatibility": "compatible|incompatible|ambiguous",
  "compatibility_reason": "brief English reason",
  "wavelengths_nm": [[400.0, 700.0]],
  "angles_deg": [0.0],
  "polarizations": ["s", "p"],
  "target_observables": ["reflectance", "transmittance", "absorptance"],
  "preferred_behaviors": ["high transmission in the explicitly stated band"],
  "suppressed_behaviors": ["low reflection in the explicitly stated band"],
  "known_stack_materials": ["layer 1: TiO2", "layer 2: SiO2"],
  "design_variables": ["explicitly requested layer thicknesses"],
  "manufacturing_constraints": ["only explicitly stated constraints"],
  "assumptions": ["only safe assumptions that do not select a material or value"],
  "ambiguities": ["unknown choices stated without guesses"],
  "method_research_questions": ["unresolved method questions"],
  "needs_method_research": false
}

Use empty lists rather than defaults when the request does not provide a value.
Output JSON only. Do not emit a solver task, optimized thickness, fabricated
material choice, invented layer count, invented numerical bound, or achieved
performance result.

{"original_request": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.", "expected_problem_id": "tmm_problem_cf712123ca1f601b", "fixed_rules": {"solver_scope": "planar laterally uniform linear isotropic layered media under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination", "unsupported": ["gratings", "metasurface lateral patterns", "anisotropic media", "chiral media", "magnetic or magneto-optic media", "nonlinear optics", "near-field tasks", "time-domain tasks"], "model": "qwen3.5-plus", "performance_targets": "preferences and research questions only; never invented hard gates"}, "repair_request": {"validation_errors": ["explicit wavelength interval 5-5 nm was not preserved"], "previous_response": "{
  "problem_id": "tmm_problem_cf712123ca1f601b",
  "original_request": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of TiO2 (n=2.40) in either order. Layer thicknesses are constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence over the wavelength range 450 nm to 700 nm (sampled every 5 nm). A mean reflectance below 0.03 is a soft scoring preference. The method must use deterministic Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) without RCWA, FDFD, surrogates, or hardware acceleration. The optimization allows up to two research rounds with one route, maximum 64 solver evaluations per round, using seed 17. Decisions to adjust or stop must be based on observed results and independent numeric checks.",
  "primary_intent": "design",
  "secondary_intents": [
    "optimize"
  ],
  "compatibility": "compatible",
  "compatibility_reason": "The request specifies a planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered medium under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination, which fits the solver boundary. All materials are lossless and constant-index, and the calculation method (TMM) is supported.",
  "wavelengths_nm": [
    [
      450.0,
      700.0
    ]
  ],
  "angles_deg": [
    0.0
  ],
  "polarizations": [
    "s"
  ],
  "target_observables": [
    "reflectance"
  ],
  "preferred_behaviors": [
    "minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance from 450 nm to 700 nm",
    "achieve mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference"
  ],
  "suppressed_behaviors": [
    "high reflection in the 450 nm to 700 nm band"
  ],
  "known_stack_materials": [
    "incident medium: air (n=1.0)",
    "layer candidates: SiO2 (n=1.46), TiO2 (n=2.40)",
    "substrate: glass (n=1.52)"
  ],
  "design_variables": [
    "layer order (SiO2/TiO2 or TiO2/SiO2)",

    "thickness of TiO2 layer (40-160 nm)"
  ],
  "manufacturing_constraints": [

  ],
  "assumptions": [

    "interfaces are perfectly sharp and planar"
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "method_research_questions": [
    "which layer order and thickness combination yields the global minimum reflectance within the evaluation budget",
    "whether the soft target of 0.03 mean reflectance is achievable given the thickness constraints"
  ],
  "needs_method_research": false
}", "instruction": "Return one corrected complete English JSON object only. Preserve every explicit value and do not add assumptions."}}
